latestVersion.changelog:
Video JoyPix 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches cloud-based AI service to turn your photos and clips into shareable 1080p MP4 videos.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG and more, up to 200MB per file.
- Automatic setup: seamless free token generation and session creation on first use.
- Offers workflows for quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
- Includes support for music, transitions, and text overlays for engaging video content.
- Allows users to check status, credits, and download results directly within the tool.
